reason: A local CLI for static and optional temporary-runtime checks of ordered DSH bundle stacks, focused on detecting Cordis patch ownership conflicts and malformed bundle contracts.

summaries.zh: 用于检查有序 DSH 配置包堆栈中的 Cordis 补丁归属冲突，并可在临时环境中运行有限运行时验证的本地命令行工具。
summaries.en: A local CLI that checks ordered DSH bundle stacks for Cordis patch ownership conflicts and can run limited runtime validation in a temporary environment.

capabilities: Reads local stack files and bundle metadata
Performs static checks for Cordis patch ownership conflicts
Optionally creates a temporary DSH_HOME and invokes local DSH commands
Outputs text or JSON findings and exit statuses
